# CD Sportswear INC

> CD Sportswear INC digitizes embroidery and makes custom patches — embroidered, woven, PVC, leather, chenille and printed — plus stickers and vector artwork, each from a file prepared for the material and tested on the machine before production. Its digital studio designs and builds what supports them: web design, development, branding, logo, digital marketing, animation, AI automation, workflow automation and SEO.

## Embroidery digitizing and patches

- [CD Sportswear INC — Embroidery digitizing, patches and digital studio](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com): Embroidery digitizing and patch production, plus an independent studio building brands and interactive 3D web experiences.
- [Embroidery Digitizing Services](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/embroidery-digitizing): Artwork turned into stitch files planned for the fabric, backing and real size, then sewn out and inspected before production — caps, hats, sleeves, towels, gloves and monograms.
- [Custom Patches with No Minimum Order](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/custom-patches): Embroidered, woven, PVC, leather, chenille and printed patches, with no minimum order, free digitizing and a free mockup before production.

## Digital studio services

- [Services — Production and digital studio](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services): Embroidery digitizing and custom patches first, then web design, development, branding, logo, digital marketing, animation, AI automation, workflow automation and SEO.
- [Web Design — Interfaces with intent](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/web-design): Brand-aligned visual systems, conversion-aware layout and responsive accessible component patterns that earn the click and the close.
- [Web Development — Next.js builds that ship](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/web-development): Full-stack web application engineering with React / Next.js front-ends, API layers, data models, auth and role-based access.
- [Branding — Identity systems](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/branding): Brand strategy and positioning, visual identity systems, and voice, tone and messaging grounded in strategy, not trends.
- [Logo Design — Marks that hold up at any size](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/logo-design): Custom mark design, wordmark and monogram exploration, and a versatile size-resilient system.
- [Digital Marketing — Campaigns tied to outcomes](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/digital-marketing): Channel strategy and measurement, paid search and social campaigns, and landing pages with conversion testing.
- [Animation — Motion that makes the complex obvious](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/animation): Explainer and product animation, 3D and WebGL experiences, and scroll-driven interface motion.
- [AI Automation — Agents that do the work](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/ai-automation): Document and content automation, triage and summarization workflows, and LLM-powered assistants and agents.
- [Workflow Automation — Connected systems](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/workflow-automation): Tool and system integration, trigger-based automation, and data sync across platforms.
- [SEO — Search engine optimization that compounds](https://www.cdsportswearinc.com/services/seo): Technical fixes, pillar pages and earned links, measured in inquiries — remote, US-wide.
